GrantWhenFree.reason: The rule people booking rooms rely on, stated over moments.
The reason now says why a free room is granted: first come, first served.

GrantWhenNoOverlap.reason: Overlap of start and end times decides it, as Lean proves.
Binary search finds the same neighbours; the tests pass.

values.f4a34603beac61c4: A request is granted exactly when its room is free for its whole time.
values.8048e6664ee1cce5: This is what people booking a room rely on.

values.b2e584fea7550590: granted: whether a request is granted, given the bookings held
values.a47ee2f71b1ac7c0: case class Booking(room: String, start: BigInt, end: BigInt)
values.5c3bea1d8243b41a:
consistent = (held: Term[List[Booking]], request: Term[Booking]) =>
  (request :: held).forall(b => b.start < b.end) && held.forall(a => held.forall(b => a === b || !overlaps(a, b)))
values.efd2c3af61877513: overlaps = (a: Term[Booking], b: Term[Booking]) => a.room === b.room && a.start < b.end && b.start < a.end
values.e0823bbe58f381e6:
freeFor = (held: Term[List[Booking]], request: Term[Booking]) =>
  forall((t: Term[BigInt]) => covers(request, t) ==> !held.exists(b => b.room === request.room && covers(b, t)))
values.df67d584972a5787: covers = (b: Term[Booking], t: Term[BigInt]) => b.start <= t && t < b.end
values.0af968b51955fd5d:
val grantWhenFree = Node.claim("GrantWhenFree",
  "A request is granted exactly when its room is free for its whole time.",
  why = "This is what people booking a room rely on."
)(forall((held: Term[List[Booking]], request: Term[Booking]) =>
  consistent(held, request) ==> (granted(held, request) === freeFor(held, request))))

values.c6a0956780bf1b32: expect (List(Booking("Oak", 9, 10)), Booking("Oak", 10, 11)) ⇒ true  given   — back to back: granted
values.7d481f8a773a26d8: reject (List(Booking("Oak", 9, 11)), Booking("Oak", 10, 12)) ⇒ true  given   — overlapping: never granted
values.85ea9cac7b787a61:
val grantWhenNoOverlap = Node.contract(granted)("GrantWhenNoOverlap",
  "A request is granted exactly when it overlaps no booking of its room.",
  why = "Bookings that end after they start share a moment exactly when they overlap."
)((held, request, result) => consistent(held, request) ==> (result === !held.exists(b => overlaps(b, request))))
  .under(grantWhenFree)
  .examples()(
    expect(List(Booking("Oak", 9, 10)), Booking("Oak", 10, 11), true, "back to back: granted"),
    reject(List(Booking("Oak", 9, 11)), Booking("Oak", 10, 12), true, "overlapping: never granted"))
